A malformed simple table renders 
nothing:

=====  ===== col1   col2 =====  ===== 
abc  xdef   g =====  =====Nor does a 
grid table with a ragged edge:

+-----+ | a    | +-----+A role before a 
literal is text: :code:x and :sub:y.
